## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` and `cargo test --workspace` pass locally
- [ ] Contract change? `pnpm gen` was run and generated files are committed (`docs/adr/0001`)
- [ ] User-visible change in a published package? `pnpm changeset` added
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] Docs / AGENTS.md updated if behaviour or commands changed
